title: Tomb Raider: Catalyst Delayed to 2028
excerpt: Amazon Games and Crystal Dynamics have pushed back the release of Tomb Raider: Catalyst to 2028, marking the second major delay for the franchise. This decision follows a pattern of rising AAA game delays as developers prioritize quality over tight schedules.
description: Amazon Games and Crystal Dynamics delay Tomb Raider: Catalyst to 2028, the second major franchise delay, continuing a trend of AAA game delays prioritizing quality.
